label: Create Cairn Passage defence and escort

value.text: Cairn Passage. Hold the relay while ComStar recovers its traffic logs, then escort a Skulker scout carrying the data to the landing zone. Your Phoenix Hawk and Trebuchet are the convoy guard.
Two contracts, one route out of the valley. Choose the operation to begin.
Mission command could not be completed. Check the mission log and deployment area.
Hold for five rounds. A Galleon guards the relay vehicle. Raiders are approaching from the northeast. Losing the relay vehicle ends the contract.
A second raider is entering the valley. The relay upload is still running.
The reinforcements cannot deploy yet. They will try again next round.
Upload complete. The relay crew pays 3,000 C-bills. Now escort the data carrier through the pass.
The Skulker crew is ready to leave.
The relay contract has failed. The surviving crew evacuates without its data.
Keep the Skulker alive. It follows the marked road around the depot to the northeast landing pad. Raiders can attack the transport. The crew drives; you control the two escort mechs.
Movement detected east of the depot. Keep the carrier covered.
The ambush is delayed. Watch the eastern approach.
The data carrier reaches the DropShip. Cairn Passage is secure. Your lance receives 4,000 C-bills for the escort. Press Space to finish.
The transport did not reach the landing zone. The escort contract has failed.

value.title: Hold the relay
value.text: Keep the relay data carrier alive for five rounds.

value.title: Escort the carrier
value.text: Keep the Skulker alive until it reaches the landing pad.
